description.en: Generates meaningful alternative equipment recommendations after the primary recommendation has been selected.
description.zh: 在首选推荐确定之后，生成具有明确差异和实际价值的备选装备方案。

core_principle.en: Alternatives must solve the same player problem through a meaningfully different tradeoff, not simply present similar products.
core_principle.zh: 备选方案必须通过不同的取舍解决同一个球员问题，而不是简单列出几个相似产品。

comfort_alternative.purpose: Reduce physical load or stringbed harshness while preserving as much performance as possible.

performance_alternative.purpose: Increase the player's primary performance goal while accepting a moderate reduction in comfort, forgiveness or ease of use.

minimal_change_alternative.purpose: Improve the current setup using the smallest possible equipment adjustment.

value_alternative.purpose: Maintain most of the performance benefit while reducing expected equipment or restringing cost.

premium_alternative.purpose: Maximize refinement, feel or overall performance where budget is not the dominant constraint.

racquet_change_alternative.purpose: Provide a frame change only when the current racquet materially limits the recommendation.
include_when: String and tension adjustments cannot solve the primary problem.
Weight, swingweight, power or forgiveness mismatch is significant.

replace_with_value_when: Premium recommendation creates large recurring cost.
replace_with_racquet_change_when: Racquet change is recommended by racquet_selection_logic.

reject_if: Alternative uses nearly identical performance DNA to the primary setup.
Only brand name changes but recommendation logic is the same.
Alternative has no meaningful advantage over the primary recommendation.
Alternative violates a hard physical constraint.

do_not: Recommend an unnecessarily powerful trampoline setup.
Use comfort as a reason to ignore durability completely.
Increase tension aggressively as the only solution.
Recommend a much heavier racquet solely for stability.

step_1.use_when: A small tension shift can reasonably solve the problem.

step_2.use_when: The player needs more or less launch, durability, feel or stability.

step_3.use_when: String DNA is the primary limitation.

step_4.use_when: Two competing goals cannot be solved by one full-bed string.

step_5.use_when: The frame itself is the major mismatch.

consider: Whether the player benefits meaningfully from the premium option
Whether a simpler full-bed setup performs nearly as well as a hybrid
value_generation_logic.rule: Do not call an option good value unless it preserves most of the important performance benefits.

premium_generation_logic.rule: Premium price alone does not justify premium ranking.

physical_constraint_logic.rule: All alternatives must pass the same physical hard constraints as the primary recommendation.
high_sensitivity_behavior: Do not generate a performance alternative that increases physical risk.
Comfort alternative becomes mandatory when appropriate.

more_control.comfort_alternative: Use softer predictable control string or hybrid.

more_power.comfort_alternative: Use elastic multifilament, gut or soft poly.
more_power.performance_alternative: Use controlled-power string or more efficient frame.

more_spin.comfort_alternative: Use soft shaped poly or spin hybrid.
more_spin.minimal_change_alternative: Use thinner gauge or modest tension reduction.

more_comfort.performance_alternative: Use soft control poly or comfort hybrid.

more_feel.performance_alternative: Use connected round poly or gut/poly hybrid.
more_feel.minimal_change_alternative: Adjust string model before changing racquet.

every_alternative_must_show: How different it is from the primary recommendation

must_do: Explain why the alternative is not ranked first.
Show the specific tradeoff versus the primary recommendation.
Keep the number of alternatives limited.
must_not_do: Do not produce five nearly identical strings.
Do not use alternatives as advertising inventory.
Do not recommend a premium option solely because it is expensive.
Do not create a performance alternative that violates physical constraints.
